purpose: Curated candidates for manual review, not a runtime asset manifest or proof of placement accuracy.
method: Public Sketchfab model/search API metadata and public model thumbnails; no authenticated download URLs or credentials are stored here.
status: First pack bundles only the three explicitly marked models; other entries remain research candidates.
common_integration_requirements: Retain author, model URL, license URL and change notices with each model actually distributed; CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution and adaptation subject to its terms.
Verify downloaded archive contents and any included attribution/provenance before redistribution.
Measure geometry in meters, verify orientation and geographic footprint, ground it against terrain, and suppress overlapping generic building geometry.
Generate useful LODs and simple collision, bound texture memory/material count, and measure runtime loading before selecting detail levels.

models.title: Washington Monument

license.basis: Public Sketchfab API license field on the retrieval date; no independent authorship warranty.

models.preview_assessment: Textured marble obelisk with a modeled circular base. Recognizable preview; inspect the base and remove or adapt inaccurate paving before placement.
before_integration: Check vertical scale against the NOAA survey and use a consistent entrance/base datum.
models.validation_limit: Converted shape/LOD/materials inspected offline; live terrain placement still needs review.
models.integration_note: Licensed plinth/materials retained. Original undersized open shaft rejected and replaced with a closed tapered shaft using NPS dimensions, preserved intact in both LODs.

models.title: Lincoln Memorial

license.basis: Public Sketchfab API license field on the retrieval date; no independent authorship warranty.

models.preview_assessment: Recognizable full temple with fluted colonnades, stepped approaches and parapet details; preview is untextured. More complete silhouette than the low-poly alternatives.
before_integration: Check column counts and footprint against references.
Inspect material availability; generate appropriate LODs and simple collision.
models.validation_limit: Converted shape/LOD/materials inspected offline; live terrain placement still needs review.

models.title: The White House

license.basis: Public Sketchfab API license field on the retrieval date; no independent authorship warranty.

models.preview_assessment: Preview includes a textured central mansion and both connecting wings, offering substantially more site coverage than the Microsoft mansion-only model.
before_integration: Verify footprint, portico orientation and wing geometry.
Reduce geometry where visually safe; inspect texture size and atlas layout.
models.validation_limit: Converted shape/LOD/materials inspected offline; live terrain placement still needs review.
models.integration_note: Cropped to the residence and porticos; mapped wings and State Ballroom remain procedural.

models.title: US_capitol_building

license.basis: Public Sketchfab API license field on the retrieval date; no independent authorship warranty.

models.preview_assessment: Preview has the recognizable Capitol dome and full wings, but also includes a large ground slab and scan-like baked surroundings. Best-looking full Capitol among the inspected downloadable results.
before_integration: Inspect source/texture provenance before redistribution; the uploader provided no description.
Remove surrounding ground and unwanted baked vegetation, preserve useful building details, then create LODs.
Use the Architect of the Capitol dimensions with the correct height datum.
models.rejection_reason: Source preview appears to depict a miniature replica with Chinese signage and an inaccurate finial; scan also includes a ground slab and vegetation.

models.integration_note: Simplified untextured geometry and broad platform require additional footprint/proportion checks before replacement.

official_scale_references.measurement: 169.046 m architectural height using CTBUH criteria; the traditional 555 ft 5 1/8 in height uses a different base datum.
official_scale_references.warning: Do not force a model including a plinth or ground slab to this height without checking its modeled base.
